items.title: India's Wholesale Inflation Jumps to 12.29% in October
items.summary: India's wholesale price inflation accelerated significantly to 12.29% in October, driven largely by surging fuel and power prices. This marks the second straight month of double-digit wholesale inflation readings for the country. Higher energy costs ripple through manufacturing and transport sectors, putting broad pressure on input costs across the economy.
items.why: Wholesale inflation tracks raw material and producer price pressures, which typically filter through to retail consumer inflation and influence central bank monetary policy.

items.title: Sensex and Nifty Gain Even as Tata Motors Drops
items.summary: Benchmark Indian equity indices Sensex and Nifty rose over 0.5% during the session, supported by buying in major banking and consumer stocks. However, individual moves varied widely as Tata Motors passenger vehicle shares slumped 8.7% after Jaguar Land Rover lowered its margin outlook for the financial year 2027. Despite broader market gains, mid-caps and small-caps faced notable selling pressure.
items.why: Market indices can rise due to strong performance in heavyweight sectors like banking, even when individual prominent stocks experience sharp selloffs.

items.title: Silver Prices Plunge 4.5% Alongside Declining Global Demand
items.summary: Domestic silver prices tumbled 4.5% to settle near Rs 1.69 lakh as precious metals faced strong downward pressure amid concerns over Federal Reserve interest rate trajectories. Silver exchange-traded funds also crashed by up to 5% following forecasts pointing to a 5% drop in global silver demand. Gold prices and gold ETFs similarly experienced downward corrections during the session.
items.why: Precious metals are sensitive to shifts in global interest rate expectations and shifting industrial demand forecasts, leading to sudden valuation swings.

items.title: Jefferies Maintains Buy Ratings on Six Adani Companies
items.summary: Global brokerage firm Jefferies maintained its buy ratings on six Adani Group firms, pointing to an expected upside of up to 44% in select stocks. The optimism stems from a projected $51 billion capital expenditure program aimed at driving 23% annual earnings and EBITDA growth. Analysts highlighted robust medium-term fundamentals across the conglomerate's energy and port operations.
items.why: Large capital expenditure plans by major conglomerates signal corporate expansion intentions, which analysts evaluate to estimate future earnings potential.

items.title: RBI Cancels Registration Certificates of 49 NBFCs
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India has exercised its statutory powers to cancel the certificates of registration for 49 non-banking financial companies. Separately, 13 other NBFCs and one housing finance company voluntarily surrendered their licenses back to the banking regulator. This regulatory housekeeping ensures tighter oversight and compliance across the shadow banking sector.
items.why: Central banks regulate non-banking financial entities to maintain systemic stability and protect consumer interests within the financial ecosystem.

items.title: National Stock Exchange Shares Hit Record High Valuation
items.summary: Shares of the National Stock Exchange surged to an all-time high, pushing the company's overall market capitalization past the landmark Rs 5 trillion threshold. The milestone reflects robust domestic investor participation, rising trading volumes, and strong financial performance by exchange infrastructure providers. The exchange handles the vast majority of India's equity trading volume.
items.why: Exchange valuations reflect the health and activity levels of the broader capital markets, benefiting directly from high retail and institutional trading volumes.

items.title: Wall Street Plummets Sharply Amid Deepening AI Selloff
items.summary: US equities closed sharply lower as anxiety intensified around artificial intelligence sector valuations ahead of upcoming corporate earnings and public offerings. The Nasdaq tumbled over 2% and the Dow Jones dropped hundreds of points as investors rotated out of high-flying tech names. Market sentiment was further rattled by leadership uncertainty surrounding key semiconductor manufacturers.
items.why: Concentrated market leadership in technology sectors means that sentiment shifts in major artificial intelligence firms can trigger broad market corrections.

items.title: Federal Reserve Assesses Economic Implications of Artificial Intelligence
items.summary: Federal Reserve officials highlighted that central bank policymakers are actively studying how emerging technologies like artificial intelligence could reshape productivity, employment, and monetary policy. While acknowledging the long-term upside for economic efficiency, officials cautioned about potential valuation risks and macroeconomic uncertainty. These assessments help central bankers determine how technological shifts might influence future interest rate decisions.
items.why: Technological revolutions impact labor markets and productivity growth, forcing central banks to factor structural economic changes into their inflation and interest rate models.
